en.title: Memories of the Scattering Blade
en.premise: “...Where should I take this sword?” she murmured, visiting the office amidst the pouring rain. In her hands, she clutched a brutally broken ancient blade and a handful of out-of-season cherry blossom petals. A murder in a locked-room antique shop. The cherry blossoms and the broken sword left at the scene—this absurd combination awakens the darkness of a sleeping town. Through a haze of cigarette smoke, I will pursue the ominous truth.

zh.title: 凋零之刃的追忆
zh.premise: “……这把剑，该带到哪里去好呢？” 在倾盆大雨中，造访事务所的女子如此呢喃。她的手中紧握着一把断裂得惨不忍睹的古剑，以及几片不合时节的樱花瓣。一起发生在密室古董店内的杀人事件。现场留下的樱花与断剑，这种荒诞的组合唤醒了沉睡小镇的黑暗。我将在烟雾缭绕中，追寻那不祥的真相。

prediction_results.question: 乾が最初に踏み込む事件の真相とは？

警察も隠す九条家の暗い過去の暴露
栞自身が犯人であるという悲劇の結末

佐伯刑事が待ち構える罠
